PDF Point-Tessellated Voxelization
Gap-free voxelization is ensured when each triangle is smaller than its destination voxel. As shown in Figure 1, we achieve this feature by subdividing the mesh with a GPU hardware tessellator (a), placing a point primitive on the centroid of each subdivided triangle (b), and rasterizing these points into a volume texture (c).
